title: Integrated lower left Dini derivative of a monotone function
statement: Let F : ℝ → ℝ be monotone and a, b ∈ ℝ. For t ∈ ℝ let D(t) := liminf_{h→0+} ofReal((F(t) − F(t − h))/h) ∈ [0, ∞], the liminf along the filter 𝓝[>] 0. Then the lower Lebesgue integral over (a, b) with respect to Lebesgue measure satisfies ∫⁻_{(a,b)} D(t) dt ≤ ofReal(F(b) − F(a)), where ofReal : ℝ → [0, ∞] is ENNReal.ofReal. No measurability of D is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), Monotone F → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((F t - F (t - h)) / h)) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (F b - F a)
